data.gender_notes: Aurelien is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name Aurelianus, which means 'Golden Mountain'. The name has been borne by several saints, including St. Aurelien of Marmoutier, a sixth-century French monk and abbot. The name Aurelien carries the meaning “Golden mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Aurelien usually hope their child will grow to embody golden mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual ascent towards the mountain of God, representing the journey towards enlightenment and closer connection with the divine.
data.etymology: Aurelien belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aurelien total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אורלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אורלין מקורו בלטינית, שמשמעותו 'זהב' או 'כסף'. במסורת הנוצרית, השם רווח בתקופה הקדומה. השם עשוי לסמל עושר, ערך, ובכורה. עם זאת, בביבליה, 'זהב' גם יכול לסמל קדושה ואמונה. בהקשר נוצרי, השם עשוי לסמל אמונה, תורה, והבטחה.

in_greek.name: Αὐρηλίνος
in_greek.meaning: χρυσός και καρδία - χρυσός και καρδιά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αὐρηλίνος προέρχεται από τη λατινική γλώσσα, και σημαίνει 'χρυσός' ή 'ασημένιος'. Στην πρώιμη χριστιανική εκκλησία, το όνομα χρησιμοποιήθηκε. Το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την ευημερία, την αξία και την πρώτη-γέννηση. Ωστόσο, στην Βίβλο, 'χρυσός' μπορεί επίσης να συμβολίζει την αγιότητα και την πίστη. Στον χριστιανικό περιβάλλον, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την πίστη, την ευσέβεια και την πιστότητα.

in_latin.name: Aurelius
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aurelianus, nunc AURELIEN, originem habet ex lingua Latina, significans 'aurum' vel 'argentum'. In Ecclesia prima, nomen huius generis usus est. Nomen potest significare 'divitias', 'pretium', 'primogenitum'. Tamen, in Scriptura Sacra, 'aurum' potest significare 'sanctitatem' et 'fidelem'. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen potest significare 'fidelem', 'sanctitatem', et 'pietatem'.

historical_references.reference: Aurelian, born Marcus Valerius Aurelianus, was a Roman emperor who ruled from AD 270 to 275. He is best known for restoring the walls of Rome and for defeating invasions by the Sassanid Persians and Vandals.
historical_references.context: Aurelian's military successes helped stabilize the empire during a time of great external threats.

historical_references.reference: Saint Aurelian, also known as Saint Aurélian, is a Christian saint who is venerated in the Catholic Church and the Anglican Communion. He is believed to have been a bishop in the city of Toulouse, France, during the late 4th century. The exact details of his life are uncertain, but he is traditionally considered a martyr who was killed during the Diocletian Persecution in the year AD 304.
historical_references.context: Saint Aurelian is remembered for his faith and devotion to Christianity, which cost him his life during a period of intense persecution of the religion.
